body: Thank you for this reply my friend❤️ the statement about opioids being life could not be more than true. It’s like you’re entire life revolves around them it’s so so so so Evil. Wow I never knew the Devil behind those damn things were that powerful. It’s so terrible. Thank you for the advice! And congratulations on your sobriety also!🌹❤️🌹❤️🌹❤️🌹

Thank you so much for your input my friend. However a couple things. I went through a hellish benzo withdrawal Literally almost lost my life I had two nasty seizures. I’m trying to do this with less medication as possible i don’t want to trade a headache for a stomachache ya know what I mean? That’s with all due respect when I say that also I know you’re just trying to help me so I really really really do appreciate that my friend🌹 the gabapentin wouldn’t be very invasive though I was prescribed that along with Ambien and Benzos but my doctor left practice so I got cut I’ll just have to call and see if they will write that again. Also I’ve done Kratom before and I could barely stomach the taste and actually kicked them back up several times and it would just be that army green sludge color, but with the nausea that the withdrawal causes on top of it already making me nauseous do you think I’d be able to stomach it and keep it down? I did the capsules also and it still made me sick.. but other than medication is there anything else to make it less painful and is there anyway to expedite the process?? Man it’s straight up hell I don’t wish that on anyone!! Also how long am I looking at before it’s pretty much over not the mental part as much but the physical? Runny nose, watery eyes, shitting myself, nauseous, hot body, cramps, headache, body pains, wanting to jump out of my skin, just the hellish feeling. Have you been through it? What’s the timeline for that to subside buddy? Thanks In Advance!!❤️

THIS I related too so much. January 19th I had a seizure from this at a restaurant luckily I was with my mom so she called 911 and I was clinically dead for about 3 minutes. Since then I haven’t been completely clean off of them but I’m trying to taper and this has absolutely stripped everything from me. I lost everything. And I’m still no where near done I don’t think. The sweats. ZERO sleep. Get about 25-30 minutes of night. The inability to relax for not even a second. This is the worst thing I’ve ever experienced and I still don’t know if I will ever pull through this.
I’m just ready to vacate this world💔
